description: Gulfstream Commander 695A, NASA CR-178004 flight 3 (bare cabin, no sidewall treatment). Base inputs for case AC_C695A_DBA (Phase 121): the runner sets rpm, pitch (for the printed shaft power), airspeed, outside and cabin air and the rotation sense per engine and condition from CR-178004 Table 4 (data/cr178004/table4_flight3_conditions.csv). Values tagged measured are printed in CR-178004; every value tagged assumed is not printed for this aircraft.
reference: NASA CR-178004 (Wilby, McDaniel & Wilby 1985) secs. 2.1-2.4, Table 4; blade: examples/bbn_aerocommander_tipA.json scaled to the printed diameter

printed_inputs.rotation: both propellers counter-clockwise seen from the rear

assumptions.blade: Aero Commander tip-A blade (bbn_aerocommander_tipA.json, R 1.18 m, itself assumed from an unverified OCR of a Hartzell manual) with radii and chords scaled by 1.345/1.18 to the printed 2.69 m diameter; twist unchanged; default clamped linear polar; loading only (t/c 0), as that file
assumptions.cross_section: circular, a = 0.725 m: half the 1.45 m cabin height (TM-85722 via IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN; width not printed)
assumptions.theta0_deg: auto floor angle for a = 0.725 m: 50.0 deg (CR-172428 App. C Merlin IVC, a = 0.84 m, nearest printed)
assumptions.L_m: 5.33 m cabin length (TM-85722 via IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN), cavity = structure (L_c = L, d = 0)
assumptions.r_p_m: a + printed tip clearance + printed tip radius = 0.725 + 0.36 + 1.345 = 2.43 m
assumptions.phi_p_deg: 90 deg: propeller axis level with the cabin axis (not printed)
assumptions.z_p_m: propeller plane (station 117) minus cabin front (station 60.5) = 56.5 in = 1.435 m
assumptions.rotation_direction: the runner gives the port engine +1 and the starboard engine -1: both turn the same way, so mirrored onto PAIN's one side they turn opposite ways; which sign is port is assumed
assumptions.d_stringer_m: 0.686 m: the upper longeron spacing (WL 28 to 55 in); the lower spacing is 0.965 m (WL -10 to 28)
assumptions.stiffener_sections: stringer, frame and floor-beam areas and inertias, floor thickness, E, nu and density: CR-3813 test-article values (aircraft_scale_hartzell_cabin_full.json), not printed for the 695A
assumptions.n_harmonics: 10, the aircraft grid's default (H10 at about 790 Hz)
assumptions.two_engines: one run per engine, interior band levels added in energy; single-engine conditions (11, 12) run the engine that is on

cabin.note: Bare cabin (flight 3). The runner overwrites rho/c (cabin air), rho_ext/c_ext (outside air) and rotation_direction per run.
